item.title: David Raya injury update
item.description: David Raya injury update David Raya will undergo further tests after failing to finish Arsenal’s 2-2 draw at Newcastle, with the club yet to establish the extent of the goalkeeper’s injury. Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images David Raya is set to undergo an MRI scan after being forced off with an apparent left-shoulder injury during Arsenal ’s 2-2 draw at Newcastle United . The goalkeeper went down after collecting a corner and coming together with William Osula who had been barging him all game to stop him releasing the ball quickly. Raya received treatment before eventually leaving the pitch holding his left arm. Kepa Arrizabalaga replaced him in the 70th minute. Speaking after the match, Mikel Arteta confirmed that Raya would be assessed, with an MRI expected on Sunday to establish the extent of the problem. “Unfortunately, he had to come off, which is never good news,” Arteta said. Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images “He will get assessed now, and probably he will have an MRI tomorrow to see what it is exactly, because at the moment, I don’t know.” Arteta was also asked about the incident which led to Raya going off. “It was a knock. I don’t know how it happened and what the injury is at the moment, so we have to wait and see tomorrow.” Before going off at Newcastle, Raya had played every minute of Arsenal’s Premier League and Champions League matches this season and it’s hard to ignore the drop-off in quality between the Spaniard and his back-up. With Borussia Dortmund and Real Madrid to come in the Champions League, alongside league fixtures against Manchester City , Brentford and Tottenham Hotspur over the next two-and-a-half weeks, Arsenal will be hoping it is not as serious as it looked. For now, though, it is too early to say whether Raya will miss any of those matches, although it seems unlikely he will be back in time for Dortmund at the least. Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images

item.title: Georgia Makes SEC History After Blowout Win Against South Carolina
item.description: Georgia v South Carolina Getty The Georgia Bulldogs have made SEC history after beating the South Carolina Gamecocks 34-6 on Saturday night. Georgia finishes its SEC regular-season schedule at 8-1 (10-1 overall) and has clinched a spot in the SEC Championship. The Bulldogs are the first team in SEC history to reach the conference title game six consecutive seasons. In the last five SEC Championship appearances, Georgia has gone 3-2. The Bulldogs won the game in 2022, 2024, and 2025. Georgia lost to Alabama in the 2021 and 2023 championship games. Kirby Smart Is Not Focused on SEC Championship Right Now Shortly after beating South Carolina, Bulldogs head coach Kirby Smart spoke to ABC’s Laura Rutledge, and he was asked about clinching a spot in the SEC title game. Smart didn’t take the bait and kept his focus on the team’s next opponent. “I would say we’ve got Georgia Tech next week,” Smart said . “I am smart enough to know what that means. Go Dawgs.” Now the question is who Georgia will face in Atlanta on Dec. 5. Alabama, Tennessee, and Texas are tied for second place in the SEC standings entering Week 13, and things would get interesting if all three teams win next weekend. Georgia Can Win Its Seventh SEC Championship Game This year’s SEC Championship game is significant because it’s the final one. The College Football Playoff is expanding to 24 teams, which means league title games are going away. “Not a real comment,” Smart said earlier this month when asked about his reaction to the SEC Championship game going away, per Sara Tidwell of the Athens Banner-Herald. “I think we all kind of knew, right? It’s not really news that it’s breaking. It’s more kind of when they decide to go to 24. Sounds like the SEC Championship will go away, and I honestly don’t concern myself with that at all. I don’t have a lot of commentary about it. “I think it’s a great, historic game. It’s great for the players, the programs, the fans. The location has been awesome for us, and the venue is incredible. All those things are awesome, but times, they are changing and as they change, we’ve got to adapt with it.” Georgia has a chance to win its 17th SEC title. The Bulldogs currently have the second-most conference championships and are behind Alabama, which has 30. Georgia will be playing in its 14th SEC title game and has a chance to win it for the seventh time. This article was originally published on HEAVY The post Georgia Makes SEC History After Blowout Win Against South Carolina appeared first on HEAVY .

item.title: Bayern Munich considering Jamal Musiala sale after health problems
item.description: Bayern Munich are considering selling Jamal Musiala over concerns that his ongoing health problems will prevent him from returning to his best form. Musiala, 23, was diagnosed with a “neurological dysfunction” after suffering an on-pitch collapse twice in a matter of days during pre-season friendlies against Heidenheim and RB Leipzig. The Germany international said he was “very optimistic... there is no additional health risk beyond this” and indicated the condition would not hamper his highly promising career. However, Bayern chief Karl-Heinz Rummenigge has now admitted that the club are assessing his future amid a downturn in performances, publicly questioning whether the club can now justify his lofty salary. Rummenigge told Sky Germany : “He has a health-related issue. It's also well known that he has a contract involving very substantial sums of money. As a club, we have to consider how to deal with that situation. I think that's responsible and perfectly normal. “What we know unfortunately suggests it will be difficult for him to get back to the level he has often shown here in this stadium.” Musiala was reportedly Bayern’s best-paid player until Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane penned a contract extension earlier this month. He has been limited to just four appearances in the Bundesliga this term due to a muscle injury, scoring one goal and notching one assist, with fitness problems continuing to plague him after spending over half of last season out with a broken leg. Rummenigge says “a decision will have to be made” over his future if he fails to show signs of improvement, but admitted that the former Chelsea academy product’s health issues would make a sale difficult. Rummenigge added: “We need to talk to the family, the player, and the agency, because then these sums of money, sorry, with all due respect, are no longer feasible. “I cannot imagine that Jamal wants to leave the club or that any other club would buy him under these conditions. “We are all interested in his return, ideally in top form. But what happens if that isn’t the case? Then we still have to think about the finances. “The discussion hasn’t taken place yet. These are just ideas at this stage.”

item.description: Motorsport photo Kelvin van der Linde charged from seventh on the grid to claim victory in a wild Macau FIA GT World Cup main race marred by controversial collisions, penalties and a miraculous escape from a 250m/h barrier impact. The WRT BMW driver profited from a string of dramatic incidents on the Guia Circuit to secure his maiden Macau crown, in a remarkable display of BMW M4 GT3 Evo's durability after he smashed into the wall at Mandarin Bend at full speed. "Honestly, I thought my race was over. Something like that happens to you once in a lifetime. I mean, look at the car. There's paint from the wall all over it. I genuinely thought it was over and even reported it over the radio. Maybe it's a bit of poetic justice after all the bad luck we had in the DTM this year," van der Linde said. ケルビンがっつり壁当て #MacauGP #FIAGTWorldCup https://t.co/sRsxV7P3cb — にっこう -nikko- (@hntzk5523) November 22, 2026 Absolute Corse Lamborghini driver Luca Engstler inherited second place after several penalties hit Thomas Preining and Raffaele Marciello, while Absolute Racing Porsche's Alessio Picariello completed the podium in third following a penalty for Augusto Farfus, despite having been caught up in an early collision himself. Just as in 2024, the decisive flashpoint revolved around a collision that wiped out the race leader – this time right at the initial start. Marciello lunged at polesitter Laurin Heinrich from several car lengths back into the braking zone for Lisboa Bend. item.title: Dickson mourns victims of Bayelsa boat mishap, seeks safety measures
item.description: Former Governor of Bayelsa State, Senator Henry Seriake Dickson, has commiserated with the families and friends of victims of the boat mishap along the Ayama/Oweikorogha waterways in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of the state. Dickson, who disclosed this in a post on his X platform on Sunday, described the incident as unfortunate and expressed sadness over the loss of lives. He also extended his condolences to the Bayelsa State Government and the people of the state over the tragedy. The senator said he deliberately scaled down his engagements on Saturday as a mark of respect for those who lost their lives in the incident. According to him, he reduced the number of visitors he attended to and cancelled some previously scheduled visits to reflect on the tragedy. Dickson commended the relevant emergency response agencies and other individuals involved in the rescue operation for their swift response, urging them to sustain their efforts until the operation was successfully concluded. He also called for stricter enforcement of maritime safety regulations and increased public awareness to prevent similar incidents. The former governor stressed the need for continuous safety education for marine operators, security personnel and residents of Bayelsa State. He further urged traditional institutions and the media to support efforts aimed at promoting maritime safety and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations. Dickson reiterated his condolences to the bereaved families, praying that God would grant the deceased eternal rest and give their loved ones the strength to bear the loss. The post Dickson mourns victims of Bayelsa boat mishap, seeks safety measures appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: ‘Get Your Box of Tissues Ready,’ ‘Not a Dry Eye in the Living Room’ — CFB Fans Emotional Over Heartwarming Commercial Featuring Kirk Herbstreit, Lee Corso
item.description: ‘Get Your Box of Tissues Ready,’ ‘Not a Dry Eye in the Living Room’ — CFB Fans Emotional Over Heartwarming Commercial Featuring Kirk Herbstreit, Lee Corso College football fans were treated to an emotional surprise on Saturday morning when Kirk Herbstreit and Lee Corso reunited in a new AT&T commercial. The 60-second spot premiered during ESPN’s College GameDay broadcast and brought back memories of the special bond the two shared for decades. Featuring a nostalgic song and a heartwarming phone call, the commercial reminded fans just how much they miss seeing Corso alongside Herbstreit on Saturday mornings. Kirk Herbstreit-Lee Corso Commercial Goes Viral Set to John Waite’s 1984 hit “Missing You,” the commercial opens with Herbstreit hitting snooze on his phone. His lock screen shows a picture of him hugging Corso. He then takes his golden retriever for a walk across a quiet college campus. When a neighbor stops to check on him, Herbstreit admits that he is “just thinking about an old friend.” The neighbor responds with a simple message: “You’re never too far away to call.” PREDICT THE CFB SEASON: PFN’s Free CFB Playoff Predictor Herbstreit takes that advice and calls Corso, who answers happily from his couch in pajamas. The 91-year-old is holding his trademark No. 2 pencil while crocheting a pillow featuring a picture of the two broadcasters. It also carries the message “LEE & KIRK BEST BUDS.” The moment becomes even more special when Herbstreit asks Corso who he thinks will win the national championship this season, bringing back memories of his famous headgear picks. However, before Corso can reveal his choice, the commercial shifts to AT&T’s wireless outage guarantee. Herbstreit ends the call with a smile, telling his longtime friend, “You still got it!” College Football Fans Get Emotional Over Kirk Herbstreit and Lee Corso Reunion The commercial quickly caught the attention of college football fans, many of whom admitted that they were emotional watching the two longtime friends together again. AT&T’s official account shared the message, “Get the tissues ready.” Former college EFL teacher Chuck Hohenstein wrote, “I’m getting so tired of Herbstreit and his dog, but damn, this is such a great commercial. I miss Coach Corso.” Former college coach Dr. Z PhD (D. Zancanelli) also praised the commercial, writing, “This is a terrific commercial for those of us who love and admire Coach Corso! Well done @AT&T.” MORE: ‘You’re Disgusting,’ ‘Something Is Seriously Wrong With Him’ — CFB Fans Slam Craig Carton Over Controversial Remarks About Kirk Herbstreit’s Dog Fans echoed the sentiment across timelines, with one viewer writing , “I miss Coach Corso too!!” Another viewer summed up the reaction with, “Not a dry eye in the living room when this came on.” The commercial brought back memories of Corso’s emotional farewell from College GameDay after 38 seasons on the popular ESPN show. The San Francisco Giants are reportedly listening to trade offers for ace Logan Webb , but the Los Angeles Dodgers and San Diego Padres appear unlikely to land the three-time All-Star. Despite growing interest in the right-hander, San Francisco faces a complicated decision involving one of its most valuable players. An MLB insider reported that an intradivision trade involving the Dodgers, Padres or Arizona Diamondbacks appears unlikely. The Giants are willing to entertain proposals following a disappointing 65-97 campaign, although they reportedly want a substantial return before considering a deal. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Webb remains an attractive option for pitching-needy contenders because of his established track record and relatively affordable contract. The 30-year-old is owed $23 million in 2027 and $24 million in 2028, giving interested teams two seasons of contractual control. However, his 2026 campaign proved more challenging. Webb posted a 4.31 ERA across 160 2/3 innings while dealing with knee bursitis and a finger blister. Potential suitors outside the NL West include the Baltimore Orioles, Toronto Blue Jays, New York Mets, Chicago White Sox, Atlanta Braves and Chicago Cubs. San Francisco could pursue younger talent to strengthen its improving farm system, particularly with expensive veterans Rafael Devers, Willy Adames and Matt Chapman proving difficult to move. Still, trading Webb would significantly weaken an already vulnerable rotation. For the Dodgers and Padres, acquiring their division rival’s ace appears improbable, even as Webb’s availability creates an intriguing offseason storyline. item.title: Official Newcastle United injury update on Lewis Hall after forced off against Arsenal
item.description: Lewis Hall Kai Havertz It was a game of varying fortunes for Lewis Hall against Arsenal. In a first half when Newcastle United struggled to even get out of their own half, the England left-back was one of the very few prepared to take responsibility and try to keep the ball, even when under pressure. When dealing with a difficult ball and facing his own goal just after the half hour mark, Lewis Hall attempted to get the ball down and keep possession. It backfired though with Kai Havertz stealing possession and played in Eze for the opening goal. Like the rest of the team, a far better second half from Lewis Hall. Especially as with Newcastle United pressing higher as a team AND doing it well, it allowed Hall to play a lot more in the opposition half and use his attacking skills on the ball to great effect. Just as an absorbing game had gone into the nine minutes of added time, Lewis Hall was left limping after he had blocked a cross and having tried to carry on, was then having to limp off a minute or so later and be replaced by Sven Botman. Following the match, Matthias Jaissle asked whether Lewis Hall was now an injury worry: “Hopefully it is only just a cramp that meant Lewis Hall had to come off. That is what we are hoping.” Lewis Hall, along with others, had put so much into this match, it could well have been cramp. I know when I played football (at a lowly level!), towards the end of the match that can easily happen, you are fatigued and then when you are stretching the blocking of a cross/pass can impact you painfully and set off a cramp. Here’s hoping. Matthias Jaissle also asked about his other England full-back. Tino Livarmento had only managed 33 Premier League minutes this season as once again impacted by injuries, in that second half though we were reminded just how good he can be, both in defence and attack. Matthias Jaissle: “Tino can definitely give us another dimension to our play but we also have to be careful and smart. He was really on the limit of what he could do. I was really proud that he could deliver 45 minutes with that physicality in such an intense match. It was really well played, a top performance, and also something that he can build on.” Newcastle United 2 Arsenal 2 – Saturday 21 November 2026 5.30pm Match Stats Goals: Newcastle United : Barnes 49, Thiaw 62 Arsenal : Eze 33 Madueke 78 Possession was Newcastle 34% Arsenal 66% Total shots were Newcastle 12 Arsenal 13 Shots on target were Newcastle 3 Arsenal 4 Corners were Newcastle 6 Arsenal 3 Touches in the opposition box Newcastle 15 Arsenal 24 Newcastle United team v Arsenal: Hornicek, Dedic (Livramento 46), Thiaw, Burn, Hall (Botman 92), Miley, Steur (Ramsey 46), Barnes, Willock (Wissa 83), Murphy (Elanga 46), Osula Unused subs: Pope, Schar, Gonzalez, Fernandez-Pardo

item.title: Mark Scheifele makes Jets history with 380th career goal
item.description: Mark Scheifele makes Jets history with 380th career goal appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Winnipeg Jets forward Mark Scheifele has officially become the franchise’s all-time leading goal scorer, moving past Dale Hawerchuk with his 380th career goal during Saturday night’s matchup against the Vegas Golden Knights. The 33-year-old reached the milestone in the second period of Winnipeg’s 5-4 shootout loss at Canada Life Centre. Scheifele converted a pass from Kyle Connor at 14:36, finding the back of the net to tie the contest at 3-3. His achievement earned him a lengthy standing ovation from the 14,107 fans in attendance. CAREER GOAL NO. 380 IS A HISTORIC ONE FOR MARK SCHEIFELE 🙌 pic.twitter.com/fDXmP85p2I Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) — Sportsnet (@Sportsnet) November 22, 2026 Scheifele’s latest accomplishment adds to an already historic season. On November 14, he became the Jets’ leader in assists and points, recording his 554th assist and 933rd point at the time. He has since extended those figures to 557 assists and 937 points, respectively, while also holding the franchise record for games played with 985 appearances. With 380 goals, 557 assists and 937 points, Scheifele now holds all three major offensive records in Jets history. He also joins an exclusive group of NHL players to lead their respective franchises in goals, assists and points, alongside Alexander Barkov and Alex Ovechkin among active players. Selected seventh overall in the 2011 NHL Draft as Winnipeg’s first pick following the franchise’s return to the city, Scheifele has spent his entire professional career with the Jets. He has compiled eight goals and 30 points through 24 games this season. Scheifele’s record-breaking goal featured familiar contributors, with Connor providing the primary assist and Josh Morrissey also picking up a helper. Connor and Scheifele have now scored in the same game 91 times. Despite the individual milestone, the Jets could not secure the win. Kyle Connor, Adam Lowry and rookie Viggo Bjorck also scored, while Stuart Skinner stopped 29 shots. The Golden Knights eventually prevailed through William Karlsson’s shootout winner after the teams remained tied through overtime.

item.title: Courtois credits Mourinho for Real Madrid’s 2-1 comeback win vs Celta Vigo: ‘His half-time talk was key’
item.description: Courtois credits Mourinho for Real Madrid’s 2-1 comeback win vs Celta Vigo: ‘His half-time talk was key’ Real Madrid came back from a goal behind to beat Celta Vigo 2-1 in their first game after the international break on Saturday night. Having fallen behind early in the game, Los Blancos mounted a second-half comeback, with Jude Bellingham scoring the equaliser before Carlos Espi bagged a late winner at the Santiago Bernabeu . The performance, especially in the first half, was far from ideal from the Merengues , on the night, but they managed to find their way back after the break. Courtois credits Mourinho Speaking to the media after the game, Thibaut Courtois credited Jose Mourinho’s half-time intervention for helping Real Madrid turn around their performance and secure victory against Celta Vigo. The Belgian goalkeeper was once again among Real Madrid’s most important performers, producing several crucial saves before his teammates completed the comeback. Courtois was particularly critical of the team’s first-half display, admitting that they had failed to meet even the basic demands of the game, and insisted Mourinho’s team-talk in the break changed things. “Mou’s halftime talk was key. In the first half, we weren’t ourselves; we didn’t run enough and we didn’t do the basics of football,” the Belgian goalkeeper explained. Courtois made some important saves to keep Real Madrid in the game. (Photo by Denis Doyle/Getty Images) “They scored an early goal, and we struggled to create chances and we weren’t good,” he added. The goalkeeper felt the difference in Real Madrid’s performance was clear after the restart as the team showed greater intensity. “We were better in the second half, we ran more and did everything better,” he noted. Praise for Bellingham and Espi Courtois then discussed Real Madrid’s comeback, stating that his confidence grew after the equaliser and seeing Espi come on as a substitute. “We scored the first goal and I had no doubt we would come back, especially when I saw Carlos come on. He’s our talisman up front and Vini put in a great cross,” he stated. Speaking further about Espi, the veteran goalkeeper added: “Espi has ​​the presence. He’s a tall, strong guy and he knows where he needs to be. He’s a natural striker. “It’s true that Kylian is less of a penalty-box player, he likes to be less like to be there, appearing on the edge of the box, and when Carlos comes on he brings presence and we know we can cross. “Yan has crossed a few times but there was no one in the box, and when Carlos came on, Vini put in a great cross. I’m very happy for him because it’s not easy.” On the summer signing’s role and contribution, he added: “Kylian is the number 9 and he doesn’t get many minutes, but when he comes on he makes the most of them, which is the important thing.” Real Madrid’s match-winner. item.title: Photos: Police take over Fountain of Life Church amid leadership crisis
item.description: …As trustees, Jimmy Odukoya trade court actions, church postpones thanksgiving service There was a heavy presence of police personnel at the headquarters of The Fountain of Life Church, Ilupeju, Lagos, on Sunday, as the leadership crisis rocking the church deepened, leaving worshippers uncertain about who would preside over the regular Sunday service. The security presence came amid a bitter dispute between Senior Pastor Jimmy Odukoya and a group of church trustees over his continued leadership of the ministry founded by his late father, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya. The disagreement has escalated into a legal battle, with both sides seeking judicial intervention over the control and administration of the church. On Friday, Odukoya approached the Federal High Court in Lagos, challenging his reported removal as senior pastor and questioning the legality of decisions taken by some members of the church’s Board of Trustees. The suit, instituted by Odukoya alongside the Incorporated Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church, named his sister, Tolu Odukoya, and seven other church leaders as respondents. The respondents include Pastor Rotimi Okpaise, Pastor Tobi Enuha, Pastor Gbenga Onabanjo, Pastor Fred Ohiani, Pastor Akin Osinbajo, Biodun Balogun and Biodun Awosika. In the court action, Odukoya is challenging the validity of meetings held by some trustees on January 22, February 28 and November 16, 2026, as well as the decisions allegedly taken at those meetings. He is also asking the court to determine whether the trustees could remove him as senior pastor without following the procedures stipulated in the church’s constitution. How the crisis started The leadership dispute became public on November 17 when a group identifying itself as members of the church’s Board of Trustees announced that Odukoya was no longer recognised as the senior pastor, with immediate effect. The trustees reportedly based their decision on a review of the church’s constitution and recorded succession instructions allegedly left by its late founder, Taiwo Odukoya, before his death in 2023. They maintained that the decision was intended to give effect to the founder’s wishes and ensure compliance with the church’s governing provisions. The group subsequently named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader pending consultations and the establishment of a substantive leadership structure. However, the announcement immediately generated a counter-reaction from the church, which rejected the purported removal and described it as constitutionally invalid. In a statement issued after the announcement, the church maintained that Jimmy Odukoya remained its duly appointed senior pastor and chairman of the Board of Trustees. It argued that his appointment in September 2023 was unanimously approved by the recognised board and that no constitutionally valid decision had been taken to remove him. The disagreement also extended to the control of the church’s communication

item.title: Sunderland Starlet Jules Ahoka Likened To Barcelona Legend After Aston Villa Display
item.description: Jules Ahoka shone for Sunderland in the 0-0 draw at Aston Villa Sunderland starlet Jules Ahoka has jokingly been compared to former Barcelona star Sergio Busquets by teammate Thomas Meunier following the Black Cats’ 0-0 draw at Aston Villa on Saturday afternoon. As Premier League action returned following the international break, Sunderland held Aston Villa to a goalless stalemate , with both sides failing to carve out enough clear-cut opportunities to break the deadlock. Despite enjoying just 27 percent possession, Sunderland still troubled the Villa defence but lacked the clinical edge in the final third to truly trouble Zion Suzuki, but managed to keep a second consecutive clean sheet after the Chelsea win before the break. After replacing injured captain Granit Xhaka in the opening minute against the Blues, Ahoka retained his place at the base of Sunderland’s midfield in the absence of the sidelined Swiss veteran, and once again enjoyed a stunning performance. Ahoka was the man of the match against Chelsea , and the 20-year-old talent was once again excellent in his full first Premier League start, which has seen his Sunderland teammate Meunier jokingly draw comparisons with the Congolese starlet to legendary former Barcelona midfielder Busquets. Sunderlsnd midfielder Jules Ahoka in action against Aston Villa (IMAGO / Pro Sports Images) Thomas Meunier compares Jules Ahoka to Barcelona Legend As he has been in every outing since signing for £8.6m from Belgian outfit Royal Antwerp in the summer transfer window, Ahoka was incredible yet again for Regis Le Bris’ side. In just his third Premier League appearance, Ahoka looked assured and in control of the midfield battle at Villa Park, with the statistics backing up Meunier’s praise. Ahoka enjoyed the most defensive contributions (16) of any player during the goalless stalemate, and also showed his quality in possession with five passes into the final third. Given his meteoric rise in the first stages of his Sunderland career, the Stadium of Light faithful have been collectively overawed by the new fan-favourite, and it appears Meunier is the latest member of the Ahoka fan club. Following Ahoka’s stunning performance against Villa, in a hilariously open interview, Meunier told Sunderland’s media : “Jules (Ahoka) was six months ago in Belgium playing for Antwerp, now he’s like f****ng Busquets… “Very honestly, he’s unbelievable, and so young, sorry for my vocabulary.” Barcelona legend Sergio Busquets (IMAGO / Zuma Press Wire) Despite the humorous nature of former PSG star Meunier’s remarks, there is a grain of truth in his comparison between Ahoka and Busquets, given that the Sunderland starlet looks just as assured in the heart of midfield as the Nou Camp legend, sharing the golden trait of appearing to have more time on the ball than any other player on the field. item.title: Celtics Player Ratings: George Tried To Carry The Offense Without Tatum In Painful Loss Against Kings
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Justine Willard-Imagn Images The Boston Celtics suffered a frustrating 97-96 loss to the Sacramento Kings , wasting a strong defensive effort and a solid performance from Paul George . With Jayson Tatum unavailable, George tried to shoulder the offensive responsibility, finishing with 19 points, eight rebounds, five assists, four steals, and a block. However, his shooting struggles reflected a much bigger problem for Boston: the Celtics simply could not get their offense going. Boston shot an abysmal 33.7% from the field and 22.4% from three-point range, missing 67 of its 101 attempts. The Celtics were particularly disastrous from beyond the arc, connecting on just 13 of 58 attempts. Despite grabbing 20 offensive rebounds and recording 22 assists, they could not turn those extra possessions into enough points. Mike Conley provided a major spark off the bench with 19 points on an almost perfect shooting night, but the supporting cast was inconsistent. Sacramento, meanwhile, took advantage of its opportunities at the free-throw line, converting 26 of 32 attempts compared to Boston’s 15 of 25. That difference ultimately proved decisive in a one-point game. Here are the player ratings for every Celtic who saw the floor. Paul George: B+ Game Stats: 19 PTS, 8 REB, 5 AST, 4 STL, 1 BLK, 3 TOV, 6-21 FG, 2-9 3-PT FG, 5-6 FT, 37 MIN George carried a tremendous workload with Tatum unavailable, contributing across nearly every statistical category. His four steals and eight rebounds demonstrated his defensive commitment, while five assists helped keep Boston’s offense connected. However, the shooting numbers tell a different story. George made just six of his 21 attempts and struggled from beyond the arc, connecting on only two of nine threes. He was far from efficient, but the Celtics needed him to shoulder a significant scoring burden. His plus-14 rating was particularly striking given the final result, and his all-around production showed how much he was trying to do. Mike Conley: B+ Game Stats: 19 PTS, 4 REB, 2 AST, 3 STL, 0 BLK, 1 TOV, 6-7 FG, 4-4 3-PT FG, 3-3 FT, 18 MIN Conley was arguably Boston’s best offensive player, and it wasn’t particularly close. In just 18 minutes, he poured in 19 points while missing only one field-goal attempt. Even more impressive, he went a perfect 4-4 from three-point range and converted all three free throws. He also recorded three steals, giving Boston valuable defensive production to go with his scoring. His plus-17 rating was the best on the team, making it difficult to understand why the Celtics couldn’t find a way to capitalize on his outstanding performance. Conley provided exactly the offensive efficiency Boston desperately needed, but his minutes were not enough to rescue the team. item.title: Bayern Munich CEO backtracks on statement suggesting a pay cut for Jamal Musiala
item.description: Over the last few days, Bayern Munich’s management has engaged in a public discussion about Jamal Musiala’s health and whether he will ever return to his previous level. Amid these discussions, CEO Jan-Christian Dreesen suggested that Musiala taking a potential pay cut may be on the cards . Facing quick backlash from fans and others for the comment, Dreesen is now beginning to backtrack. “Jamal is a player we have particularly high hopes for, and we obviously want him to return to the level he was at when we extended his contract. Perhaps that is also an expression of those expectations. But this has absolutely nothing to do with putting pressure on him. That wouldn’t make any sense at all. When a player re turns from injury—and here we’re talking exclusively about the injury, not the absence seizures—he needs time,” said Dreesen (as captured via @iMiaSanMia ). He continued: “I did not say that we need to revisit his contract; I just explained that Jamal was injured for two months and is now returning. I also already answered your earlier question about whether we or a nyone else had any knowledge of this [before the contract extension]. We had no knowledge of it, and I’ve answered that clearly. So there’s no need to discuss contracts. We have a contract in place until 2030. It’s absolutely clear, and therefore there is no discussion to be had about that.” This clarification from Dreesen gives the impression that Bayern are now struggling to do damage control after realizing the severity of their blunder by holding these discussions in public. It doesn’t help his case, and it looks as though things could play out to be quite messy. What do you think of Dreesen trying to walk back his comments, and how will all of this end? item.title: What Brent Brennan, Mays Pese and Gio Richardson said after Arizona’s OT at Kansas State
item.description: MANHATTAN, KS - NOVEMBER 21: Wide receiver Giovanni Richardson #5 of the Arizona Wildcats runs into the end zone for a two point conversion against cornerback Nick McClellan #34 of the Kansas State Wildcats in the second half at Bill Snyder Family Football Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Manhattan, Kansas. (Photo by Peter Aiken/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Arizona football coaching staff knew there was a chance the Wildcats would get a rain game in Manhattan, Kansas. They also knew there was no way to adequately prepare for the tropical storm like conditions Arizona faced Saturday night practicing in Tucson’s 75-degree weather. “Full disclosure, there’s zero way to prepare for that, zero,” Arizona coach Brent Brennan said after his team’s 35-28 overtime win at Kansas State. Despite facing adverse weather conditions and a double-digit fourth quarter deficit, Arizona hung on for its eighth win of the season. “This was special, and winning at a place like this that is always hard to play at,” Brennan said. Our recap of the game can be found here , as can our game grades . Below is what Brennan, defensive lineman Mays Pese and wide receiver Gio Richardson had to say postgame. Brennan on the victory: “Well, first of all, hats off to Coach Klein and Kansas State. Those kids played their ass off tonight. It was a hell of a football game, so I just give them a lot of credit. I’m super proud of our team. They just kept believing, they kept fighting, they kept playing, battled through some incredible conditions that I think probably most of the kids on our team haven’t played in for a while, or even some of our staff hasn’t coached him for a while, but we finished the job and I think that what good teams do. [Noah] Fifita is an absolute warrior. He is without question the one of the best players in college football, and that should be not even hard to see. His ability to complete passes when he had to, in those circumstances is unreal, absolutely unreal. Winning doesn’t cover up the fact that we still have work to do. There were some missed opportunities there, some things that we can coach better, some things that we can fix. But I’m just incredibly proud of our team, just their belief, their fight, how they kept playing for each other, and we’ve got stuff to work on, but we’re going to celebrate the hell out of this. This was special, and winning at a place like this that is always hard to play at. You throw in the weather and the wind and the cold, and our kids just kept showing up for each other, and that is special. This football team is really special.” On winning under difficult circumstances: “I think it gets back to something that we’ve talked about before: what choice do you have? They’re not going to call the game because it’s raining. They’re not going to call the game because it’s cold. That was something we talked about all week. item.title: PSG star Doue in tears after suffering worrying knee injury against Nice
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain star Desire Doue was stretchered off in tears after suffering what looked like a nasty knee injury as the reigning French and European champions beat Nice 3-2 in Ligue 1 on Saturday. Doue went down after twisting awkwardly late in the first half as he tried to control the ball, shortly after scoring to put PSG 2-1 ahead. He looked in agony as he clutched his right knee, and the match was stopped for five minutes to allow Doue to receive treatment before being carried off to a backdrop of applause from the crowd at the Allianz Riviera stadium. PSG will now be dreading discovering the extent of the injury, having lost Khvicha Kvaratskhelia to a ruptured anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee playing against Barcelona last month. The Georgian winger is unlikely to return this season, and Doue looks set for a significant spell on the sidelines too. “We will need to wait until tomorrow for the test results, but it is obviously a serious injury,” PSG coach Luis Enrique told broadcaster Ligue 1+. The 21-year-old French international, who can play on the wing or in midfield, has been arguably PSG’s best player this season after playing a key role in their Champions League triumphs in each of the last two campaigns. He has notably scored three goals in three Champions League appearances this season for PSG, who sold Bradley Barcola to Liverpool at the beginning of the campaign and have seen Ousmane Dembele struggle with his fitness recently. – ‘Not a problem’ – “This is the life of a professional player at the very highest level,” added Luis Enrique. “You just have to accept it and I am sure he will find a way to recover well and come back even stronger.” Asked about the possibility of moving to sign a replacement in the January transfer window, the Spanish coach said PSG were “always open to possibilities”. “We have players who can come in and we will overcome this as a team. It is not a problem,” he added. Earlier, Algerian international Mohamed Amoura had given Nice the lead only for Senny Mayulu to equalise with a penalty awarded after a VAR check following a handball in the home box. Doue — who was wearing a mouthguard after one of his teeth became dislodged while playing for France against Italy during the international break — put PSG ahead a minute after that goal, turning in at the back post from an Achraf Hakimi assist for his sixth of the season in all competitions. His replacement Ferran Torres scored PSG’s third in the 85th minute, controlling in the box before finishing on the turn for his eighth goal of the season — but first in two months. Ali Abdi pulled one back for Nice in stoppage time, but their run of three straight wins was ended as PSG made it 12 victories on the bounce. Eight of those wins have come in Ligue 1, in which PSG are now five points clear at the top from Lille, who lost 1-0 at home to Lyon with Mads Bidstrup scoring the only goal. item.title: COP31 faces collapse threat as latest draft fails to mention fossil fuels
item.description: The COP31 presidency proposed an eleventh-hour deal Sunday that again fails to mention fossil fuels — an omission that deepened a tense standoff at the UN climate talks. The latest offering by summit co-hosts Turkey and Australia published deep into overtime leaves unresolved tensions over planet-heating fossil fuels but retains a much-sought goal to electrify the global economy. The proposal needs consensus approval from nearly 200 nations at a closing session Sunday but they have struggled to bridge differences during two weeks of grinding negotiations. The European Union and other nations have pushed for strong language on transitioning away from fossil fuels, a call that has faced resistance from oil-rich Saudi Arabia. An EU official told AFP the latest proposal was a “backwards” step, warning there was a “very real possibility” that COP31 ends with no deal. “I am more pessimistic today than I was yesterday,” the official said on condition of anonymity. “The situation is difficult, and the outcome is uncertain. The oil-producing countries are putting up a fierce fight,” a German official said. A Saudi official declined to comment when approached by AFP. Fossil fuels are a flashpoint at the climate talks and the summit comes against a difficult backdrop of soaring energy prices and geopolitical tensions stemming from the war in Iran. A draft deal unveiled earlier this week called for a faster phase out of fossil fuels but a second, pared-down version released Thursday stripped away all mentions of coal, oil and gas. Threats of a walkout prompted Turkey and Australia to convene a hurried meeting between the European Union and Saudi Arabia in a bid to broker a compromise. The latest text introduces a reference to a previous global deal in 2023 to shift the world away from fossil fuels — but stops short of naming them explicitly. And it retains a contentious push to expand carbon capture and storage, a technology championed by the fossil fuel industry but criticised as costly and ineffective in cutting emissions. “We are very disappointed with how the text looks,” the environment minister of Antigua and Barbuda, Michael Joseph, told AFP after leaving the COP31 presidency’s offices. “I can’t honestly say that I’m okay with it passing” in its current state, Joseph said, adding that the draft was “quite silent” on fossil fuels. – Goal to electrify – The draft also calls for global efforts to boost the share of electricity in total final energy consumption to 35 percent by 2035 and the expansion of “clean energy”. The summit had been under pressure to show progress in tackling soaring greenhouse gas emissions in a year of climate-linked disasters from Europe to Nepal and Indonesia. Facing blowback over fossil fuels, Turkey and Australia pointed to “electrification” as a way to cut heat-trapping emissions and bolster energy security. item.title: Kwara jailbreak: 20 officers queried as investigation reveals escape plans
item.description: By Demola Akinyemi Ilorin About 20 officers of the Medium Security Custodial Centre, Oke-Kura, in Ilorin, Kwara State, are being investigated over last Wednesday’s jailbreak by two condemned inmates. Vanguard reliably gathered that among those now facing scrutiny are members of the armed squad and duty officers on round-the-clock supervision of inmates at the facility. According to dependable sources (names withheld), probes indicate that last Wednesday’s jailbreak was a larger, coordinated effort involving seven inmates. According to insider accounts, the inmates spent months secretly chiseling through the wall of their cell without prison management detecting it, pasting a poster over the opening to conceal the gradual breach. On the morning of the escape, the convicts were said to have tied blankets to make a makeshift rope, throwing it to hook the broken bottles on the high perimeter fence. “While the first two convicts successfully scaled the wall and fled, the rope snapped under the weight of the remaining five inmates, sending them falling back,” the source hinted. Contacted,the Spokesperson of the state command, Adegbulugbe Phillips Olumide, however, could not confirm the development. “I cannot confirm the report; those who came to investigate the incident returned to Abuja yesterday,so there’s no report on the outcome yet.”he said Recall that the Controller General of Nigerian Correctional Service Sylvester Nwakuche,who visited the scene on Thursday, attributed the escape of two condemned prison inmates to negligence, describing the incident as unfortunate and unacceptable. Nwakuche also vowed that staff found guilty in the incident would be dealt with severely. He, however, assured that a security dragnet has been spread across the state and the country and that the two escaped condemned criminals would be rearrested. Meanwhile, the inmates identified as Shegun and Abraham, who reportedly escaped on Wednesday after breaking and scaling the wall of the custodial centre to ease their escape, have been declared wanted by the centre. item.title: Messi deserved red card for throwing ball at opponent, says Columbus coach
item.description: Columbus Crew coach Laurent Courtois said Lionel Messi should have been sent off after hurling a throw-in at an opponent as Inter Miami crashed to a 3-0 defeat in the MLS Cup playoffs on Saturday. Messi’s frustration boiled over on the stroke of half-time when he aimed a forceful throw-in into the face of Columbus Crew forward Gonzalo Tapia with 10-man Miami trailing 1-0 at the time. Messi and Tapia both were shown yellow cards for the incident by referee Allen Chapman, but Courtois said afterwards the Argentina superstar should have been given a red card. “Everybody knows that he deserved more than a yellow card,” Courtois said in a post-game press conference when asked about the incident. “It’s just really sad.” Referee Chapman later defended the decision to only show Messi a yellow. “The force used was negligible and the offense did not reach the level of violent conduct,” Chapman told a pool reporter. Inter Miami had already been reduced to 10 men when the incident occurred and were 1-0 down after Chile international Tapia’s early penalty. Reigning MLS champions Miami went on to suffer a 3-0 defeat, with Tapia grabbing a second after a Taha Habroune strike just after half-time at Miami’s Nu Stadium. The result means seventh seeds Columbus, the 2023 champions, can eliminate Messi and Miami from the playoffs with a victory in game two of the best-of-three series in Ohio next Friday. “It was a game where nothing went right for us, and we effectively created their chances for them,” Miami coach Kily Gonzalez said afterwards. “We didn’t produce the great performance we had hoped for. Everything went wrong, but we have to learn from it because next time, if we don’t win, we’re out,” he added. “There’s no better challenge for us as a team than this. It’s a test of character, and I know my team has that character.” In other MLS playoff action on Saturday, Joaquin Valiente scored two goals as host Dallas beat Portland 3-0 in their Western Conference series opener. The 25-year-old Uruguayan midfielder scored in the 53rd and 55th minutes and Samuel Sarver added an insurance goal in the fourth minute of stoppage time for Dallas, who can advance by winning at Portland next Saturday. US teen Peyton Miller scored one goal and set up another in New England’s 2-0 victory over visiting Philadelphia. Miller’s 10th-minute shot deflected in off Philadelphia defender Nathan Harriel to make it 1-0 and the 19-year-old scored in the 73rd minute off a Jack Harrison cross to complete the scoring. New England can advance to the MLS Eastern Conference semi-finals with a road victory next Saturday. Vanguard News The post Messi deserved red card for throwing ball at opponent, says Columbus coach appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Troops raid bandits’ hideout in Kogi, recover AK-47 rifles
item.description: By Kingsley Omonobi Troops of the Nigerian Army have dislodged suspected armed bandits from a hideout in Kogi State, recovering two AK-47 rifles, three magazines and 65 rounds of ammunition during an intelligence-led operation. The operation, conducted on Saturday, November 21, 2026, targeted suspected kidnappers operating in the Osara, Gada and Ohakiti forest areas of Okehi Local Government Area, following intelligence reports on their activities and hideouts. In a statement, the Acting Director, Army Public Relations, Colonel Appolonia Anele, said the operation was launched by troops deployed from Patrol Base Kabba in collaboration with other security personnel. She said the operation was aimed at dismantling criminal hideouts linked to the recent spate of kidnappings along the Kabba–Okene Road and neighbouring communities. According to the statement, troops encountered about six armed bandits at an abandoned settlement within the forest during the offensive, engaging them and forcing them to flee. A subsequent search of the hideout led to the recovery of two AK-47 rifles, three magazines and 65 rounds of 7.62mm special ammunition. Other items recovered from the enclave included bags, torchlights, food supplies and a power bank believed to have been used by the fleeing suspects. The Army said the operation underscored its determination to deny criminal elements freedom of action, dismantle their operational bases and restore security along vulnerable routes and communities in Kogi State. It reaffirmed its commitment to sustaining intelligence-driven operations in collaboration with other security agencies to eliminate threats to lives and property. The Army also urged members of the public to continue providing timely and credible information to security agencies to support ongoing efforts to identify and clear hideouts used by criminal elements across the country. The post Troops raid bandits’ hideout in Kogi, recover AK-47 rifles appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Customs seize ₦3.52bn contraband in Ogun
item.description: …Recover cannabis, codeine syrup, 1.45m tablets, others By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta The Nigeria Customs Service (NCS), Ogun I Area Command, has intercepted contraband goods with a total Duty Paid Value (DPV) of ₦3.52 billion in a series of operations aimed at curbing smuggling, protecting public health and safeguarding the nation’s economy. The seized items include 6,037 wraps of cannabis, 20,500 bottles of codeine-containing cough syrup, more than 1.45 million tablets and capsules of various brands, foreign parboiled rice, petroleum products and vehicles. The items were inspected and paraded by the Comptroller-General of Customs during a visit to the Command. According to a statement issued on Saturday by the Command’s Public Relations Officer, Assistant Superintendent of Customs, Paul Gimba, the total value of the seized goods with available valuations stood at ₦3,517,838,700. The statement said the seizures reflected the Command’s sustained efforts to combat smuggling and prevent the circulation of prohibited and potentially harmful products in the country. A breakdown of the seizures showed that cannabis accounted for 6,037 wraps, valued at ₦1.268 billion, while 20,500 bottles of codeine-containing cough syrup had a DPV of ₦147.6 million. The Command also intercepted 828,920 tablets of various brands, valued at ₦795.76 million, and 627,320 capsules worth ₦376.39 million. Other pharmaceutical products seized included 2,850 ampoules of Enox 4000 injection, valued at ₦17.1 million, and 95 prostate pills worth ₦570,000. The seizures further included 5,173 bags of 50kg foreign parboiled rice, valued at ₦455.22 million, and 1,067 used tyres worth ₦52.82 million. In the petroleum products category, Customs intercepted 1,037 kegs of 25 litres of Premium Motor Spirit (PMS), valued at ₦34.22 million, and 1,008 kegs of 25 litres of Automotive Gas Oil (AGO), worth ₦44.35 million. Other seized items comprised 21 packages of walkie-talkies, 185 packages of sanitary pads and diapers valued at ₦18.13 million, 125 live cartridges and two trucks with a combined valuation of ₦144 million. The Command also recorded seizures of several used vehicles, including a 2024 Toyota RAV4 and a Toyota Highlander valued at a combined ₦50 million; two Lexus vehicles worth ₦25 million; a 2000 Toyota Hilux valued at ₦11 million; a 2013 Toyota RAV4 worth ₦17 million; and a Toyota Sienna valued at ₦14.7 million. Other vehicles intercepted were a 2010 Toyota Venza valued at ₦14.6 million, an Opel worth ₦7.3 million, a Mazda valued at ₦7.1 million and a 2012 Range Rover Sport worth ₦17.2 million. item.title: APOD: 2026 November 22 – Swirls and Colors on Jupiter from Juno
item.description: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 22 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Swirls and Colors on Jupiter from Juno Explanation: What creates the colors in Jupiter’s clouds? No one is sure. The thick atmosphere of Jupiter is mostly hydrogen and helium , elements which are colorless at the low temperatures of the Jovian cloud tops . Which trace molecules provide the colors remains a topic of research , although small amounts of ammonium hydrosulfide are one leading candidate . What is clear from the featured color-enhanced image — and many similar images — is that lighter clouds are typically higher up than darker ones. Pictured, light clouds swirl around reddish regions toward the lower right, while they appear to cover over some darker domains on the upper right. The featured image was taken by the robotic Juno spacecraft in 2018 during its 14th low pass over Jupiter . Juno continues in its looping elliptical orbit, swooping near the huge planet every 33 days and exploring a slightly different sector each time around. item.title: Review: Godzilla Minus Zero joins the list of truly stellar sequels
item.description: It's a rare thing for a film sequel to match or even surpass its predecessor; The Godfather Part II and Terminator 2: Judgement Day are the best known examples on a pretty short list. Go ahead and add Godzilla Minus Zero to that list. Director Takashi Yamazaki's sequel to his critically acclaimed Godzilla Minus One (2023) is everything one could want in a Godzilla movie: human pathos, great special effects, and, ultimately, two giant kaiju duking it out over who gets to destroy Japan (and eventually the world) the most. (Spoilers for the first film below. Spoilers for Minus Zero but no major reveals until after the gallery. We'll give you a heads-up when we get there.) As I wrote previously , Yamazaki wanted to return to Godzilla’s filmic roots with Minus One , setting the events in postwar Japan and tapping into the monster’s symbolic representation of the Japanese perspective on the 1940s nuclear holocaust—while also incorporating all-too-human themes of guilt and redemption. That first film focused on kamikaze pilot Kōichi Shikishima (Ryunosuke Kamiki), who struggled with survivor’s guilt after he failed to take action when Godzilla attacked the Japanese base on Odo Island in 1945. item.title: ‘I Struggled To Come Out, Lost My Sister, Other Relatives,’ Bayelsa Boat Accident Survivor
item.description: A survivor of Friday’s boat accident in the Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State has recounted how she struggled to escape from the capsized vessel, saying she lost several members of her family and neighbours in the tragedy. The woman, whose identity was not immediately disclosed, said her elder sister, her sister’s daughter-in-law and two children belonging to her relatives and neighbours were among those who died in the accident. Recounting the incident, she said the boat suddenly capsized, trapping passengers beneath it. “The boat just fell and pressed all of us. My elder sister’s son’s wife was lost. My elder sister was lost. Her son was also lost. One of my neighbours who followed us also lost her son. My neighbour herself was lost,” she said. ﻿ The survivor said she was the only person among those close to her who made it out alive, adding that she struggled to escape after the boat overturned. “It’s only me that is safe. When I came out, somebody held me. I was drinking water. I was not able to come out. I struggled before I came out. Where we were standing, the boat broke from above and pressed us down,” she said. Asked by the Bayelsa governor, Douye Diri, whether the bodies of her missing relatives and neighbours had been recovered, she replied in the negative. Her account comes as the death toll from the accident has risen to 23, while 24 survivors are receiving treatment in hospitals. The accident occurred near Oweikorogha Community in the Ukubie area of Southern Ijaw when a boat conveying mourners from Ayama Community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony capsized at about 11 a.m. on Friday. ﻿ The Bayelsa State Police Command confirmed the incident, saying preliminary findings indicated that the boat developed a mechanical fault while navigating the waterways. However, a survivor had also alleged that the wooden passenger vessel, popularly known as a ‘love boat’, was overloaded with passengers and their belongings, raising concerns about possible breaches of waterway safety regulations. President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to the families of the victims and directed relevant federal disaster response agencies to support rescue and recovery operations. In a statement posted on his X account, Tinubu described the incident as tragic and said those who died did not deserve to lose their lives in such circumstances. “Those who lost their lives in the tragedy did not deserve to die that way. I have directed all relevant Federal Disaster Response agencies to work together to ensure a successful recovery and rescue operation,” he said. The President also directed that Saturday’s presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State, be held without much fanfare in honour of the victims. item.title: Can Enzo Maresca Win The Premier League In His First Season At Man City?
item.description: Six league titles. Ten years. A stand at the Etihad with his name on it. Good luck following that. Enzo Maresca has to, after Manchester City unveiled him as manager back in June 2026. Maresca at least knows his way around the training ground. Back in 2020-2021, he ran the Elite Development Squad and won Premier League 2 with them. He returned in 2022 to work under Guardiola as an assistant, and that season ended with the treble. So this is spell number three, and he’s tied down until 2029. Expectations at City don’t reset just because the man in the dugout has changed. City’s title odds have become some of the most debated in premier league online betting markets because bookmakers must weigh a campaign shaped as much by events off the pitch as on it. A Flying Start, Then A Bump The opening weeks went better than almost anyone expected. Maresca became the first manager in Premier League history to win his first seven games in charge of a new club. The football looked familiar too. City kept the ball and wore teams down, which is no surprise from a coach who learned so much from Guardiola. His Leicester and Chelsea sides played the same way. City spent big to help him. Their summer outlay of around £460 million was a record for any club, and £125 million of it went on Enzo Fernández from Chelsea, a fee that matched the Premier League transfer record. Phil Foden signed a four-year extension. Rodri, one of the faces of the Guardiola years, left for Barcelona. Maresca has won quickly before. He lifted the Championship title with Leicester in 2023-24. A year later at Chelsea, he won the Conference League and the Club World Cup and still finished fourth in the league. Seven straight wins at the start of a season guarantee nothing, of course. Plenty of fast starters have slid down the Premier League table once the winter fixtures arrive. City soon lost three league games in a row, one of them a 1-0 home defeat to Brighton, who had never won away at City before. Then there are Arsenal. Mikel Arteta, another former Guardiola assistant, ended their 22-year wait for the title in 2025-26, helped along by a Premier League record for goals from corners. Manchester City’s Italian manager Enzo Maresca gestures on the touchline during the English Premier League football match between Manchester City and Sunderland at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, north west England, on September 20, 2026. (Photo by PETER POWELL / AFP) The Fight Off the Pitch The bigger problem might be off the pitch entirely. Early in the 2026-27 season, an independent commission found City guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules. It ruled that the club used “sham” contracts with commercial partners to inflate revenues and cut costs by more than £900 million between 2009 and 2018. City deny any wrongdoing and have appealed. If the verdict stands, they face a heavy sanction, and a big points deduction is one of the options on the table. So Maresca could get everythi

item.title: Death Toll In Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 23
item.description: The death toll from Friday’s boat accident in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State has risen to 23, with 24 survivors receiving treatment in hospitals. The accident occurred when a boat conveying mourners to a burial ceremony capsized near Oweikorogha Community in the Ukubie area of Southern Ijaw. The Bayelsa State Police Command confirmed the incident in a statement, saying the boat was travelling from Ayama Community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony on Friday, when it capsized at about 11 a.m. A preliminary police report indicated that the boat developed a mechanical fault while navigating the waterways. Following the incident, rescue operations were launched, with several passengers rescued while others were initially reported missing. A survivor had also alleged that the wooden passenger boat, popularly known as a ‘love boat’, was overloaded with passengers and their belongings, suggesting that this might have contributed to the accident. President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to the families of the victims, describing the incident as tragic and directing relevant federal disaster response agencies to support rescue and recovery efforts. In a statement posted on his X account, Tinubu said, “Those who lost their lives in the tragedy did not deserve to die that way. I have directed all relevant Federal Disaster Response agencies to work together to ensure a successful recovery and rescue operation.” The President also directed that the presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State, on Saturday, be held without much fanfare in honour of those who lost their lives. “On behalf of the entire nation, I mourn those who lost their lives in the incident and sympathise with their families, the government and the people of Bayelsa State. “I particularly mourn with Governor Douye Diri over this sad incident. I pray that God Almighty repose their souls and comfort their families,” he said. Meanwhile, Governor Douye Diri has visited the scene of the accident and is expected to initiate a probe into the circumstances surrounding the tragedy. The state government has also warned boat operators against overloading, reckless navigation and travelling without life jackets, stressing the need for strict compliance with waterway safety regulations. It also emphasised the importance of enforcing safety measures to prevent a recurrence of such incidents. ﻿ The post Death Toll In Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 23 appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: China Diaries: The Railway Connecting Continents
item.description: Standing at the Xi’an International Port Station in northwest China, watching the movement of freight trains preparing to transport goods across borders and continents, I was reminded that economic development is not only about what a country produces. It is also about how efficiently it can move what it produces to the rest of the world. Xi’an occupies an interesting place in China’s history. It was once the starting point of the ancient Silk Road, which connected China to Central Asia, the Middle East and Europe through centuries of trade and cultural exchange. Today, the city is reclaiming that historic role through a modern railway network that connects Chinese manufacturing centres to markets across Europe and Asia. The China-Europe Railway Express is one of the most visible outcomes of China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI). Through this network, freight trains transport automobiles, electronics, machinery, textiles, agricultural products and other goods across the Eurasian continent. What makes the initiative particularly interesting is how it has transformed the economic possibilities of a city located thousands of kilometres from the sea. Xi’an has become an important international logistics hub, demonstrating that geographical distance from a coastline does not have to limit a city’s participation in global trade. The railway network has continued to expand. By November 2025, China-Europe freight trains had completed nearly 120,000 journeys, connecting 232 cities in 26 European countries and more than 100 cities in 11 Asian countries. The value of goods transported through the network had reached $426.4 billion by the end of 2024. These are not merely impressive transportation figures. They represent an evolving system of economic connectivity, linking manufacturers, suppliers, distributors and consumers across national borders. Beyond transportation: The economics of connectivity The significance of the railway goes beyond moving containers from one destination to another. It creates opportunities for businesses to reach markets faster, diversify their supply chains and reduce their dependence on a single transportation route. Rail freight offers an important middle ground between air and sea transportation. While it is generally more expensive than shipping by sea, it can be considerably faster. For certain categories of goods, particularly machinery, automobile components, electronics and other time-sensitive products, that difference can be commercially significant. It also provides an alternative when disruptions affect other transportation routes. Another important feature is the development of inland logistics infrastructure. Warehousing, customs processing, container handling, industrial parks and distribution services have grown around railway connections. This means the economic benefits are not confined to the railway operators. They extend to businesses, workers and communities along the routes. This is an important lesson i

item.title: Chelsea Humbled As Leeds Run Riot
item.description: Chelsea suffered an embarrassing 4-1 defeat against Leeds on Saturday as the Blues were beaten for the third time in their last four Premier League matches. Xabi Alonso’s side were ripped apart by rampant Leeds, who savoured their first Premier League win at Stamford Bridge in 27 years. Chelsea scored six in a League Cup win against Leeds in September, but Daniel Farke’s men erased that painful result with a superb display on their return to West London. Just 24 hours after NFL legend Tom Brady was linked with buying a minority stake in Chelsea, the seven-time Super Bowl winner might be thinking twice about his mooted investment. Leeds United’s English goalkeeper #01 James Trafford and Leeds United’s Swiss striker #19 Noah Okafor celebrate after the English Premier League football match between Chelsea and Leeds United at Stamford Bridge in London on November 21, 2026. (Photo by Henry NICHOLLS / AFP) Brady is believed to be friendly with Chelsea co-owner Behdad Eghbali, who will have a big decision to make on Alonso’s future if results do not improve soon. Chelsea are languishing in eighth place after a fifth defeat in their 11 league games under Alonso, who was hyped as the stabilising force the club needed after a turbulent period. Alonso has been hampered by the absence of injured Brazilian striker Joao Pedro in recent weeks, and once again Chelsea struggled without their attacking talisman. Making his full debut in Alonso’s latest bid to find a stand-in for Pedro, Emmanuel Emegha fired Chelsea ahead in the 25th minute. Yet within three minutes they gifted an equaliser to Noah Okafor, who punished static defending to lash home. Morgan Rogers conceded a penalty eight minutes into the second half, and Dominic Calvert-Lewin converted to put Leeds in front. Swiss striker Okafor quickly made it three in the 58th minute and Brenden Aaronson got a fourth in stoppage time to leave Chelsea in turmoil. Over a miserable five-match spell, the Blues have lost to Tottenham, Sunderland and Leeds, while also crashing out of the League Cup against Liverpool. While it is too soon to suggest Alonso is in danger of the sack, the Spaniard has endured a disappointing start to his first spell as a Premier League manager. Failing to beat struggling pair Nottingham Forest and Crystal Palace in their next two games would undoubtedly turn the heat up on the former Real Madrid and Bayer Leverkusen boss. The post Chelsea Humbled As Leeds Run Riot appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: On this day in space! Nov. 21, 1676: Danish astronomer discovers speed of light — by accident — while observing Jupiter's moon Io
item.description: null On Nov. 21, 1676, the Danish astronomer Ole Rømer discovered the speed of light . Before Rømer figured it out, scientists thought that light travels instantaneously, or infinitely fast. Rømer disproved this almost by accident when he was studying Jupiter's moon Io . He was trying to figure out how long it takes Io to orbit Jupiter in hopes of using it as a cosmic clock. He watched Io disappear behind Jupiter and reappear on the other side. He did this over and over every 42 hours for years. To his surprise, the timing of the eclipses was not consistent. When Earth was closest to Jupiter, the eclipses happened 11 minutes early. Likewise, when the two planets were farthest away, the eclipses were 11 minutes behind schedule. Rømer figured out the pattern and made an accurate prediction for Io's eclipse on Nov. 9, 1676. Then on Nov. 21, he took his findings to the Royal Academy of Sciences and explained that a finite speed of light must be responsible. Danish astronomer Ole Rømer (Image credit: Wikimedia Commons) Why it mattered Understanding that the speed of light is a constant is the key that opened our ability to gauge the scale of the universe, as well as was central to developing modern physics. "The speed of light becomes a sort of ultimate speed limit," Live Science explained in an article about why the speed of light matters. "In fact, objects with mass, be they cars or neutrinos, can't reach the speed of light because they would need infinite energy to do so."

item.title: Amazon’s first digital photo frame is up to 50 percent off for Black Friday
item.description: Amazon only announced its first digital photo frame less than a month ago, but it’s already getting a sizable discount for Black Friday. You can currently grab the Alexa Photo Frame at Amazon and Best Buy starting at $114 ($115 off), making it a great holiday gift for anyone who loves displaying family photos. If you prefer the walnut trim over the birch or standard black models, it’s also on sale at Best Buy for $134.99 ($95 off) — which, like with the others, is the first discount we’ve seen. Amazon Alexa Photo Frame Where to Buy: $229.99 $114.99 at Amazon (birch) $199.99 $114.99 at Best Buy (black) $229.99 $134.99 at Best Buy (walnut) The Alexa Photo Frame features a 10-inch, semi-matte touchscreen that’s designed to make digital photos look more natural, with built-in light sensors that automatically adjust brightness throughout the day. It displays images from Amazon Photos, which supports uploads from both iOS and Android devices, including photos stored in iCloud. You can choose which people or albums to display, or let Alexa Plus do the work, which often results in photos based on your facial expression, the season, and even the lighting. You can also search for specific photos with voice commands, letting you easily pull up images of your first dog, your child as a baby, and other shots without having to scroll endlessly through years of photos yourself. If you want to add a more personal touch, Amazon also lets you attach voice notes to individual photos via the Amazon Photos app. For example, you can add a recording of your kid explaining their Halloween costume to a trick-or-treating photo. Plus, you can preload the frame with photos and recordings before gifting it, so your loved one won’t have to spend time setting it up. We’re still testing Amazon’s answer to the Aura frame, but it looks like a particularly good option if you’re already an Amazon Prime member. A Prime subscription grants you unlimited full-resolution photo storage and access to Alexa Plus at no additional cost, and unlike Amazon’s smart displays, the frame doesn’t serve up annoying ads. That said, you don’t need a subscription to use it, and new users can always access a limited-time trial of Alexa Plus.

item.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?

The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet. The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of caring about and investing in AI safety while also being a public company beholden to shareholders. Oh, and it also continuously growing the amount of money it makes so it can keep paying its ever-increasing compute bills, which total roughly $900 billion over the coming years. All of these ideas sit in a fascinating tension with one another, and so Hayden and I really tried to break down how we think this might play out as Anthropic navigates the pressures of the public markets. We also get into why OpenAI seems happy to have let Anthropic go public first , and why Anthropic’s whole pitch to big customers boils down to the same safety branding that now sits in conflict with the profit-oriented part of its business. item.title: 'Star Trek: First Contact' at 30: Resistance is futile when it comes to the 'Next Generation' crew's greatest big-screen adventure
item.description:
Richard's love affair with outer space started when he saw the original "Star Wars" on TV aged four, and he spent much of the ’90s watching "Star Trek”, "Babylon 5” and “The X-Files" with his mum. After studying physics at university, he became a journalist, swapped science fact for science fiction, and hit the jackpot when he joined the team at SFX, the UK's biggest sci-fi and fantasy magazine. He liked it so much he stayed there for 12 years, four of them as editor. 

He's since gone freelance and passes his time writing about "Star Wars", "Star Trek" and superheroes for the likes of SFX, Total Film, TechRadar and GamesRadar+. He has met five Doctors, two Starfleet captains and one Luke Skywalker, and once sat in the cockpit of "Red Dwarf"'s Starbug.  

Following the sad news of Sir Patrick Stewart's passing , there's been no shortage of discussion about his best moments as Captain Jean-Luc Picard . "The Inner Light"'s life in 25 minutes is a strong contender, as are the courtroom grandstanding in "The Measure of a Man" and his insistence (under extreme torture) that "there are four lights!" in "Chain of Command". But for this writer's money, it's hard to look past a nine-minute sequence in "Star Trek: First Contact", which turns 30 this weekend. With the Borg overrunning the newly launched USS Enterprise-E, Picard — who has long-standing beef with the Collective, following his assimilation in classic "The Next Generation" story " The Best of Both Worlds " — orders his crew to fight the cybernetic nasties hand-to-hand if required, defying their pleas to activate the ship's self-destruct system and retreat. He even calls Worf — not a man renowned for dodging a fight — a coward, prompting the Klingon to respond that, "If you were any other man, I would kill you where you stand." Ouch. But following some impassioned talk about making the Borg "pay for what they've done", he's finally talked down from his rage by 21st-century stowaway Lily Sloane (Alfre Woodard). She points out that his Moby-Dick-esque obsession is on the verge of going full Ahab, and he eventually sees sense, issuing the order to abandon the Enterprise and destroy the hive. It's a masterclass showcasing the ever-brilliant Stewart's impressive range, as the out-of-control captain's rarely seen temper reaches fever pitch, before normal service is resumed. His subsequent apology to Worf — "As a matter of fact, I think you're the bravest man I've ever known" — is simply perfect. And just as the franchise's zenith, "The Wrath of Khan", is built around Kirk and Khan's decades-old feud, "First Contact" is precision engineered to get the most out of Jean-Luc. This was the right "Star Trek" at the right time, a film that put "TNG"'s greatest villains on a collision course with the origins of Starfleet. It's not quite "Khan", of course — what is? — but it deserves to be mentioned in the same breath. (Image credit: Paramount) In 1996, the "odd numbers bad, even num
